CalculatedColumns.Name: OrderStatus
CalculatedColumns.Expression: CASE WHEN [RawStatus] = 'ready' THEN 'OPEN' WHEN [RawStatus] = 'done' THEN 'CLOSED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END

CalculatedColumns.Name: ActiveUnits
CalculatedColumns.Expression: CASE WHEN [RawQuantity]-COALESCE([RawCancelled],0) < 0 THEN NULL ELSE [RawQuantity]-COALESCE([RawCancelled],0) END
